steps.en: Install the hey binary for your platform
steps.zh: 为自己的平台装上 hey 二进制

steps.en: Run hey once and sign in with your browser
steps.zh: 跑一次 hey，用浏览器完成登录

steps.en: Completes OAuth and stores the token in your system keyring
steps.zh: 完成 OAuth，把令牌存进系统钥匙串

steps.en: Connect the coding agent it detected — or any MCP client
steps.zh: 接上检测到的编程 agent，或任意 MCP 客户端
steps.code: hey setup claude · claude mcp add hey -- hey mcp

steps.en: Installs the embedded skill and serves hey_* MCP tools on your account
steps.zh: 装好内置 skill，以你的账号提供 hey_* MCP 工具

steps.en: Ask the agent to work your mail — or type the commands yourself
steps.zh: 让 agent 处理你的邮件，或自己敲命令
steps.code: hey box view imbox · hey reply 12345 -m "Friday works for me."

steps.en: Reads come back as Markdown or JSON with --jq; writes carry the keyring token to HEY's API
steps.zh: 读回 Markdown 或 JSON，写操作带着钥匙串令牌发往 HEY API

value.en: Mail, calendar and contacts become agent-callable — no browser tab, no screen-scraping, no IMAP wrangling
value.zh: 邮件、日历、通讯录都变成 agent 可调用的能力——不开浏览器、不抓屏、不折腾 IMAP

sources: https://github.com/basecamp/hey-cli README — Install (curl installer, mise), Getting started (hey browser sign-in), Using the CLI (box view, reply), Coding agents (hey setup claude, claude mcp add hey -- hey mcp)
https://github.com/basecamp/hey-cli docs/agents.md — skill install to ~/.agents/skills/hey, hey mcp gateway tools on the signed-in account
https://github.com/basecamp/hey-cli docs/cli.md — output formats (--json, --jq), system-keyring credential storage
